# Write Dart and Flutter unit tests with package:test

Curated by Skill Harbor — @flutter's skill for writing Dart and Flutter unit tests with `package:test`: organize test files to mirror `lib/` under `test/` with the `_test.dart` suffix (`integration_test/` for integration tests); import `package:test/test.dart` (or `package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart` for Flutter); group related tests with `group()`, define cases with `test()`, assert with `expect()` and matchers (`equals()`, `isTrue`, `throwsA()`); write async tests with plain `async`/`await`; manage setup/teardown with `setUp()`/`tearDown()`; use `package:mockito` alongside `package:test` for dependency injection; pick the runner per project type (`dart test` for pure Dart, `flutter test` for Flutter, explicit directory for integration tests). Includes a sequential test-implementation workflow with a copyable checklist and a feedback loop (run → review stack trace → fix → re-run until green), plus worked examples (a standard unit test suite; mocking with `@GenerateNiceMocks`). Honest caveats: methodology only — you need the Dart or Flutter SDK installed; the deep Mockito mock-generation guidance lives in the companion skill dart-generate-test-mocks in the same repo. BSD-3-Clause licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
